text: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and understand text in a useful way. One common use is translation, where NLP helps software turn writing from one language into another. NLP is also used for sentiment analysis, which means finding out if a text is positive, negative or neutral. This is helpful for companies that want to know what customers think. Another popular example is chatbots, which use NLP to talk with people and answer their questions. Thanks to NLP, computers can now communicate with us in a more natural and helpful way.
